description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance of various Fine-tuning Methods for two different RoBERTa Sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Fine-tuning Method," and displays seven methods in the following order: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "GLUE Performance," using a linear scale with numeric tick marks at 86 and 88, indicating a tick label interval of 2. The vertical axis does not start at zero, with the visible range extending from approximately 84 to just above 89. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each fine-tuning method category contains two side-by-side bars representing the "RoBERTa Size," as indicated by the legend. The left bar in each group represents the "base" size and is colored blue, while the right bar represents the "large" size and is colored orange. The approximate GLUE Performance values vary across the methods and sizes. For the "base" size (blue bars), values range from the shortest bar in the chart at approximately 84.3 for BitFit to approximately 87.0 for the S5-model. Other "base" values include roughly 84.6 for Prefix, 84.4 for Adaptor, 86.6 for LoRA, 85.6 for S1-model, and 86.2 for S4-model. For the "large" size (orange bars), values range from approximately 85.6 for the S1-model to the tallest overall bar in the chart at approximately 89.3 for the S5-model. Other "large" values are approximately 85.7 for Prefix, 88.1 for Adaptor, 89.0 for LoRA, 87.7 for BitFit, and 87.6 for S4-model. The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending, descending, or alphabetical order, and there are no visually emphasized bars through shading, bolding, or annotations.
